description: Na₇Co₃O₈ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are seven inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.88 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three CoO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.60 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two CoO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-48°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.35 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.69 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.97 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three CoO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.56 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.88 Å. There are three inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one CoO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-51°. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.82-1.97 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two CoO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 53-54°. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-2.02 Å. In the third Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one CoO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-47°. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-1.97 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Co atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Co atoms to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₄Co₂ pentagonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Co atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Co atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na and two Co atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Co atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two equivalent Co atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na and two Co atoms.
